anonymous_public_sources.establishes: 2–110 children, Equal/Increasing/Decreasing/Random, variance up to10%. Marketing simultaneous wording is not a V3 atomic strategy contract.
Anonymous HTML identifies current public index.

calculateScaledOrder, calculatePrices, calculateQuantitiesUSDTByQuantityDistribution, calculateIncreasingDifferenceCoin, calculateIncreasingRatioCoin; Equal and Difference UI defaults. Difference base weights1..n and reversed, Ratio powers of two and reversed; quote denominator sum(price*quantityWeight). Source read only, no JS execution or private requests.
Ordinary LIMIT/GTC signed POST and original-ID GET. batchOrders max5 is one HTTP batch limit, not a Scaled plan limit; current client keeps sequential ordinary orders.

client_financial_rules.precision: Decimal and exact Rational through division/alignment. No finance doubles/Number conversions. All final children pass current ordinary-order rules, funds, trading eligibility, LIMIT/GTC capability.
client_financial_rules.prices: Inclusive endpoints, distinct valid ticks. low+floor(spanTicks*i/(count-1))*tick. Reject invalid, off-grid or too-narrow endpoints; do not alter user range.
client_financial_rules.weights: Equal1; Increasing Difference1..n, Ratio2^i; Decreasing reverses weights. Same quantity distribution semantics for base and quote, independent of BUY/SELL.
client_financial_rules.base: Ideal qty=total*w/sum(w). Floor on LOT minimum+k*step, reject ideal below minimum and nonrepresentable aggregate total; apportion remaining steps to largest fractional remainders, ties to lowest price. Total base quantity is conserved exactly.
client_financial_rules.quote: Ideal qty=quote*w/sum(price*w). Floor each to LOT minimum+k*step. Reject minima/filter failures instead of increasing input or clamping to maxima. Exact sum(price*qty)<=input; unallocated quote explicitly displayed and never automatically spent. No leverage multiplication.
client_financial_rules.random: Existing controller creates one public 32-bit seed when Random first chosen or explicit reshuffle; seed remains in immutable local draft. Pure integer LCG1664525/1013904223 modulo2^32, paired deviations (sample%20001-10000)*variance/100 around weight10000, optional unpaired weight10000, deterministic shuffle. Weights sum=count*10000. Validate final rounded child qty within entered0..10% of actual mean; otherwise concrete variance/step error. Rebuild, locale, prepare, intent revalidation, submit and recovery never draw new randomness.
client_financial_rules.margin: Exact total limit notional/leverage before netting, fees, pending orders and released margin. Not spend cap, final margin, fill assurance or executable allowance.

deliberate_differences_from_public_front: Do not reproduce float conversions, hidden min clamps, silent aggregate base loss or upward budget inflation. Rounding/remainders are explicit Vanta rules, not claimed bit-for-bit Aster calculations.
Public quote Difference Decrease branch uses n-i+1 while base/common weights use n-i. Vanta consistently reverses1..n for both units.
Public source random path uses unbounded relative0.5..1.5 excess weights; Vanta follows official product variance<=10%, captures deterministic seed and checks actual post-step quantities.
presentation: UI defaults quote unit, BUY, all four primary fields blank, Equal with hidden Difference; preserves independent raw base/quote inputs. Progressive modes expose Difference/Ratio, Random exposes variance default10 and explicit reshuffle. Preview/review/results show ten children per page without truncating frozen plan, all110 accessible; result page follows newly active child. Dialog resolves l10n on rebuild.
execution: Existing same connected EOA or already-created Privy wallet; no new wallet/agent. Exact independent client IDs and ordinary LIMIT/GTC base quantity only. Fresh signed funds/config read per child, signed POST and separate original-ID query; ascending price, sequential. Full-plan not atomic, may partly succeed; many wallet confirmations possible.
recovery: Pre-POST durable journal freezes each sent child. Failure/rejection/unknown/stop/route exit/config drift stops unsent children. Unknown only rechecks original sent IDs; no resampling, resizing, retransmission, rollback cancellation or automatic continuation. Wallet identity/type/signing change invalidates callbacks. Intent also rejects peg/trigger/trailing/attachments/reducing/close/quick/TIF tampering.
deferred: Real Aster authorization/fills, native persistence/signature return/layout/accessibility and iOS build unverified. User explicitly deferred device tests. Full PRD remains incomplete (Portfolio, Swap, Chase/full strategy management, first navigation, etc).
